AMETEK reports two segments: **Electronic Instruments Group (EIG)** and **Electromechanical Group (EMG)**. All figures are reported "net sales" in USD millions (GAAP). Since AMETEK's fiscal year is the calendar year, and Q4 results are disclosed via an earnings release/8-K rather than a 10-Q, the most recent four reported quarters as of Oct 3, 2026 are Q3 2025 through Q2 2026.

| Q1 2026 | Mar 31, 2026 | 1,264.5 | 663.9 | 1,928.4 |
| Q2 2026 | Jun 30, 2026 | 1,321.2 | 723.2 | 2,044.4 |

- **EIG** (the larger segment, ~63–65% of sales) dipped sequentially in Q1 2026 but rebounded to a record $1.32B in Q2 2026 (+13.9% YoY), driven by a 7% organic increase plus 7% from acquisitions.
- **EMG** has grown steadily, with Q2 2026 sales a record $723.2M (+16.9% YoY on 15% organic growth and ~2% acquisitions), contributing to strong margin expansion.
